card.statement:
Let $P\in \mathcal N_q^-$. If $\Omega_{\psi_i}(s)P=0$ for all $s\in
\mathbb Z$ and all $1\leq i\leq N$, then $P$ is a constant multiple of $1$.
card.label: Lemma 14

paper.title: Kashiwara Algebras and Imaginary Verma Modules for $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{g}})$
paper.abstract: We consider imaginary Verma modules for quantum affine algebra $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{g}})$, where $\hat{\mathfrak{g}}$ is of type 1 i.e. of non-twisted type, and construct Kashiwara type operators and the Kashiwara algebra $\mathcal K_q$. We show that a certain quotient $\mathcal N_q^-$ of $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{g}})$ is a simple $\mathcal K_q$-module.
